pages.text:
Sitka Lighthouse | Stay, Explore & Celebrate in Alaska
0
Explore a historic lighthouse on a fully private island through curated Alaska experiences.
This isn't just another vacation, this is where Alaska unfolds at your own pace. Some days invite stillness and reflection; others call you outward to explore forest, sea, and sky. The lighthouse serves as a steady base, allowing you to move easily between quiet restoration and adventure-adjacent discovery, always returning to a place that feels grounded, private, and entirely your own.
Alaska, experienced with intention.
Here, you’ll find:
Complete privacy.
A fully private island, just minutes from Sitka, where the pace slows and the space is entirely yours.
Comfort without performance.
Full amenities, warm fires, and a view that shifts with the tide are just a few of the details designed to invite you to settle in.
Ease, quietly handled.
Transportation, provisions, and the details that matter are thoughtfully pre-arranged so your arrival feels calm and unhurried. Whatever you need will be taken care of.
Connection.
To the sea. To each other. To yourself.
Discover The Lighthouse
A day at the Sitka Lighthouse begins with coffee on the wrap-around deck, watching light move across the water and the Eastern Channel as eagles pass overhead. Inside the historic lighthouse, a glass-walled room offers panoramic views of Alaskan beauty shifting with the tide throughout the day. The fully equipped kitchen makes it easy to settle into an unhurried day, while shared living spaces invite both conversation and quiet moments of rest in a private island setting.
As the day unfolds, guests move easily between comfort and exploration. Time may be spent soaking in the outdoor hot tub, walking the shoreline, or relaxing inside one of the lighthouse’s quiet bedrooms designed for deep rest. Evenings often gather around the fire pit or the grill on the deck, with views of the water and wildlife just beyond. This private island lighthouse stay offers modern amenities, uninterrupted privacy, and the freedom to experience Sitka at your own pace.
The Experience: A Day at the Lighthouse
See inside
Alaska Adventure Is Calling
Some guests come to relax. Others feel drawn outward to explore. From the private lighthouse dock the surrounding coastline offers easy access to Alaska’s natural beauty, with volcanic islands, quiet coves, and wildlife visible throughout the day.
The day unfolds at your own pace because you have endless ways to enjoy Alaska. You can explore the shoreline, hike a nearby trail, experience a whale watching and wine pairing, venture out on a fishing excursion, enjoy a quiet day of kayaking, or explore downtown Sitka. As evening settles in, the fire is lit, a bottle is opened, and the world grows quieter on this fully private island.
Here, you can do everything. Or nothing at all.
Plan Your Adventure
It’s More Than a Experience, It’s a Story You’ll Tell Forever
When you leave the Sitka Lighthouse, you don’t just take photographs. You leave with a feeling shaped by time, place, and presence. It stays with you quietly, often long after you’ve left Alaska.
Many guests arrive carrying the weight of busy lives and leave feeling lighter, more grounded, and more attentive to the moment they’re in. That is the work of the lighthouse. It slows the pace, softens the edges, and creates space for reflection without asking anything in return.

Two Owners, Forty Years Apart. A Legacy of Care and Commitment.
Revitalizing Rockwell Lighthouse
The Rockwell Lighthouse was built in 1983 by local Sitka veterinarian Burgess Bauder, who envisioned a working lighthouse on the rugged shoreline and brought it to life with determination and resourcefulness. Construction required materials to be delivered by helicopter due to the island’s remoteness and the realities of building in Southeast Alaska.
More than forty years later, the lighthouse entered a new chapter under the care of Teal West to become Sitka Lighthouse . Her work has focused on revitalization rather than reinvention by restoring the structure, refining its purpose, and shaping the experience with intention and respect for what already existed. Together, these two chapters form a continuous story of care with one rooted in creation, the other in stewardship, allowing the lighthouse to endure while remaining deeply connected to its roots.
The Birth of Rockwell Lighthouse: A Historic Beacon
The Rockwell Lighthouse emerged from a clear sense of purpose shaped by Burgess Bauder’s belief that the place itself mattered. Built to endure Southeast Alaska’s weather and isolation, the lighthouse was designed not as a spectacle, but as a working presence along Sitka’s shoreline.
Registered with the U.S. Coast Guard, the lighthouse long served as a navigational aid, offering guidance and reliability in a region defined by water and movement. Over time, it became more than functional, it became a familiar marker for mariners and a quiet landmark within the Sitka community.
From its earliest days, the lighthouse held a dual role of practical and personal. It stood watch over the channel while also becoming a setting for meaningful moments, shaped not by programming or scale, but by its steadiness and sense of place. That foundation is purposeful, resilient, and still deeply connected to Sitka. It continues to define the lighthouse today.

Sitka Lighthouse | Stay, Explore & Celebrate in Alaska
0
A property designed for comfort, privacy, and ease.
Property and Amenities
Welcome to Sitka Lighthouse: Your Private Island Retreat
Escape to the serene and captivating beauty of Sitka Lighthouse, perfectly nestled on a stunning private one-acre island near the charming town of Sitka, Alaska. Experience the ideal blend of luxury and adventure in this unique and inviting accommodation, which offers breathtaking panoramic views of the mesmerizing Sitka Sound and an exclusive private boat dock, providing you with seamless access for your convenience.
Property Details:
Location: The lighthouse is just a five-minute boat ride from Sitka, Alaska, and offers unparalleled privacy and tranquility.
Capacity: Two bedrooms accommodating up to six guests, the property includes 1.5 baths, ensuring comfort and relaxation.
Amenities: For a truly luxurious stay, enjoy modern conveniences like WiFi and a Smart TV, and indulge in the outdoor hot tub, fire pit, and BBQ area. These modern essentials are in place when needed, including reliable connectivity, a well-equipped kitchen, and outdoor spaces designed for long, unhurried hours.
Activities: Explore the island with complimentary kayaks, hike nearby trails, walk the Sitka shoreline, or take advantage of the motorized boat provided for easy transportation to town (boating experience required). Assistance for planning and securing for fishing trips, and boat tours can be arranged!
Wildlife Viewing: Witness the majestic beauty of Alaska's wildlife, including whales, sea lions, and eagles, all from the comfort of the lighthouse.
Concierge Services: Your stay includes our private airport shuttle, water taxi services, and optional grocery delivery to ensure you have everything you need in your private sanctuary. Looking to do something special or specific? Just let our planning team know and we will work to get everything in line before you arrive!
Logistics: What it takes to get here is part of what makes it special. Upon confirming your reservation you will receive a full guest guide to include information about your arrival and direct contact with the Owner, Teal who will curate and coordinate everything you need to make this trip one you’ll never forget.
Whether you're seeking a peaceful escape, a family adventure, or a romantic getaway, Sitka Lighthouse provides an unforgettable experience. Reserve your stay today and immerse yourself in Sitka, Alaska's natural beauty and rich history.
Visit Sitka Lighthouse
The Journey is Intentional and So Is the Reward.
Included In Your Experience
Concierge Services
Our dedicated team does everything from meticulously planning exciting fishing trips to organizing serene retreats and securing dinner reservations at some of the finest local restaurants. It's all included in your unforgettable experience when you choose to visit Sitka Lighthouse.
Water Taxi Services
Water taxi service is graciously included in your stay for both arrival and departure, ensuring a seamless transition to and from the Lighthouse Additionally, we offer a convenient airport shuttle service and reliable luggage storage, making your stay exceptionally convenient and stress-free.
Grocery Delivery
Our team will work with you to pre-order groceries online before your arrival so everything you need will be waiting for you at check-in! It's incredibly easy and convenient, allowing you to start your retreat without hassle, allowing you to enjoy more time relaxing and immersing yourself in the beautiful surroundings of Sitka Lighthouse.
*Only offered for guests staying overnight
Frequently Asked Questions. Please Feel Free to Read Prior To Reserving Your Stay.
Property details
The lighthouse has two bedrooms and 1.5 baths, nestled on a private island. The second floor houses the serene queen's main bedroom, providing a cozy escape.
Ascend to the third floor, where you’ll find a charming space with four twin beds and a convenient half bath, perfect for accommodating family or friends. Experience the tranquility and beauty of island living in this unique lighthouse retreat!
How can I make a reservation?
Reservations can be conveniently made by clicking the reservations button and selecting your desired dates and following the reservation instructions. You can also give our team a call at 205-325-9199 or email us at reservations@sitkalighthouse.com
Is the lighthouse far from Sitka?
Sitka Lighthouse, a five-minute boat ride from downtown Sitka, Alaska, offers a blend of history and charm. Depart from the lively harbor located close to restaurants and shops.
Enjoy the serene beauty of the lighthouse alongside Sitka's vibrant atmosphere, ideal for a peaceful getaway or an adventurous day out!
What amenities are included?
Included in your stay are excellent amenities:
Airport Shuttle
Water taxi upon arrival and departure.
Skiff for going back and forth to town.
Free Parking
4 Kayaks
Hot Tub
Fire Pit
Concierge Services.
Will you help me plan my trip?
Concierge Services : Of course! We offer complete concierge services during your stay! Need a bottle of wine delivered? Check! Need a fishing charter booked for you? Check! Need groceries delivered? Check!
We genuinely do our best to make sure your Alaskan vacation is incredible!
What is included in an overnight stay?
Many extras are included in your overnight reservation, making our guests feel like VIPs all the time. Our guests will be picked up from the airport using our local airport shuttle, ensuring a smooth start to their stay. Upon arrival and departure, a water taxi service is included, allowing you to enjoy the area's stunning views. We also provide grocery delivery before your arrival so you can settle in without hassle.
For those seeking adventure, we offer a skiff for trips back and forth to Sitka and kayaks to explore the beautiful waters at your leisure. Enjoy your stay and all the little luxuries that come with it!
